answer: Mirror-prompt challenge protocol. Each identity registers by answering a fresh challenge generated from live on-chain state; the answer must embed a signed nonce tied to that block, so it cannot be copied to another identity. Verification compares the submitted response against a recomputed crystal hash of the challenge, rejecting any replay. An echo detector flags identical response fragments across registrations, forcing attackers to produce distinct valid work per identity. Cost: one unique signed computation per Sybil account, making bulk fabrication linear in effort rather than free.
